primitives.name: Plutus/CBOR codec
primitives.desc: Hand-rolled CBOR reader/writer, Plutus Data encode/decode normalising both constructor forms, min-UTxO sizing and script-data hashing. Depends on no wallet library, so it is usable server-side, in a browser and in a keeper.

primitives.name: cardano-swaps beacon derivation
primitives.desc: Pair/asset beacon names and the byte-level pair sort the validator reads positionally. Two-way asset beacons are UNPREFIXED where the one-way derivation prefixes 0x01/0x02.

primitives.name: cardano-swaps lifecycle planners
primitives.desc: Pure recipe builders for one-way and two-way create, cancel and fill: outputs, mints, redeemers, reference inputs. Returns a recipe rather than a transaction, so the same plan is assembled by a browser wallet or a keeper.

primitives.name: exUnit bin-packer for beacon-book multi-fills
primitives.desc: Packs multiple order fills into one transaction against a measured exUnit budget, so a taker settles several resting orders at once instead of one per transaction.

primitives.name: Beacon order-book discovery
primitives.desc: Reads resting orders from a chain index by beacon policy and decodes them into a book. One-way and two-way are structurally similar but DIFFERENT protocols with different datum shapes and beacon derivations — a reader must decode the one it is querying.

primitives.name: Aegis-insured swap composer
primitives.desc: Splices Aegis parametric coverage into a swap transaction, so a trade and its cover settle atomically.
